run.name: UBS Group AG
run.title: CP-OS host session (UBS)
run.summary: UBS Group AG looks like a strong, well-capitalized and liquid bank credit. Its main risks come from the pending Swiss capital rules and legacy litigation, not from weak earnings or debt service. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and balances at central banks (balance sheet); of cash and cash equivalents of 231,375 USD m, 19,118 USD m was not available for general use

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Interim 2026 statements and instrument terms are missing, and the Swiss rule outcome is unresolved.
CP-1 main limitation: There are no interim financial statements for 2026, so current-quarter figures are rounded spoken claims.
